```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R.packages.R")
```

Code for Part 1 example:
```{r}
# Input instructions and create dataframe with direction and amount of spin
import_instructions <- function(input_file) {
  data_in <- read_lines(here::here("data", input_file)) |>
    tibble(value = _)
  data_in |>
    mutate(direction = str_sub(value, 1, 1),
           amount = as.integer(str_sub(value, 2)),
           shift  = if_else(direction == "L", amount, -amount))
}

# Create dial and set to initial value
create_dial <- function(start, end, init) {
  dial <- start:end
  dial <- shift(dial, n = init, type = "cyclic")
}

data_calc <- import_instructions("day01_example.txt")
dial <- create_dial(0, 99, 50)

# The actual row-by-row loop
count_zeros <- 0
for (i in seq_len(nrow(data_calc))) {
  dial <- shift(dial, n = data_calc$shift[i], type = "cyclic")
  if (dial[1] == 0) {count_zeros <- count_zeros + 1}
}
```

Answer for Part 1 example: `{r} count_zeros`

Code for Part 2 example:

```{r}
# Input instructions and create dataframe with direction and amount of spin
# Also, we want the number of times around the dial and the actual change
# in location on the dial.
import_instructions <- function(input_file) {
  data_in <- read_lines(here::here("data", input_file)) |>
    tibble(value = _)
  data_in |>
    mutate(direction = str_sub(value, 1, 1),
           total_amount = as.integer(str_sub(value, 2)),
           full_spin_count = floor(total_amount / 100),
           mod_amount = total_amount %% 100,
           shift  = if_else(direction == "L", mod_amount, -mod_amount)
           )
}

data_calc <- import_instructions("day01_example.txt")
dial <- create_dial(0, 99, 50)

# The actual row-by-row loop
count_zeros <- 0
for (i in seq_len(nrow(data_calc))) {
  start_dial <- dial[1]
  dial <- shift(dial, n = data_calc$shift[i], type = "cyclic")
  end_dial <- dial[1]

  if (data_calc$direction[i] == "L") {
    if (start_dial != 0 && end_dial != 0 && start_dial - end_dial < 0) { count_zeros <- count_zeros + 1  }
  }
  else {
    if (start_dial != 0 && end_dial != 0 && start_dial - end_dial > 0) { count_zeros <- count_zeros + 1  }
  }
  if (end_dial == 0) {count_zeros <- count_zeros + 1}
  count_zeros <- count_zeros + data_calc$full_spin_count[i]
}
```

Answer for Part 2 example: `{r} count_zeros`
